cards.claim: John Greny had been entrusted with the sacred responsibility of leading a diocese as its diocesan bishop.
cards.quote: John Greny, a devoted servant of the Lord, had been entrusted with the sacred responsibility of leading a diocese as its diocesan bishop. This esteemed position, one of great trust and authority, was not taken lightly, and Greny's appointment was a testament to his unwavering commitment to the Church. As the bishop in pastoral charge of his diocese, Greny's duties were multifaceted and far-reaching. He was responsible for the spiritual well-being of his congregation, providing guidance, support, and wisdom to those seeking solace in the teachings of Christ. His role was not limited to mere ceremonial duties, but rather, he was an active shepherd, tending to the needs of his flock with compassion, empathy, and understanding. One of the most compelling pieces of evidence supporting Greny's position as diocesan bishop was his involvement in the appointment of parish priests within his diocese.

raw_card.claim: Bishop John Greny has been sworn in as a United States senator.
